micro_interview.question: Suppose you build a model that performs very well on historical data but degrades sharply after deployment. How would you determine whether the cause is overfitting, data leakage, distribution shift, or an implementation problem?

micro_interview.practice: Take 6 minutes to create a diagnostic tree, then give a 3-minute English answer. For each hypothesis name one concrete test and what observation would increase or decrease your confidence in it.
